prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprite sheet for Wacha Wacha Town. The supplied reference contains FOUR existing characters, top to bottom, each shown in two original poses. Create new poses of EXACTLY these four people, one person per row. Preserve each face, body proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hat, accessories, outfit construction and EXACT clothing colors. No redesigns or recolors. Match their crisp hand-painted storybook chibi rendering and gentle overhead three-quarter perspective. True transparent alpha background. No floor, scenery, stairs, labels, text, grid lines or shadows under feet. Every cell has generous empty gutters and complete head, hands and feet. Keep fixed character scale and foot baseline across a row; animate limbs and posture, do not translate the character across cells. EXACT GRID: FOUR equal rows by EIGHT equal columns, 32 separate sprites. Each row is one expressive, coherent EIGHT-FRAME seamless loop of the stated role action, with clear anticipation, contact/effort, follow-through and recovery. Hands interact convincingly at waist/chest height with portable tools or an unseen counter in front-right. Keep the original portable tools; do not attach a large counter, building, chair or floor to the sprite. Facing front-right three-quarter. Make genuinely different body poses, not identical copies. Landscape canvas, ideally 1536 by 1024. Stage: 海辺のマルシェ. Stage locations: 鮮魚市場|荷揚げ岸壁|釣り桟橋|食堂の2階|網修理小屋|海辺のテラス|灯台の入口|砂浜.
Row 1: S03-C021, 網漁師 1; action context: 網を引き上げる.
Row 2: S03-C026, 網を繕う職人 1; action context: 縫い物をする.
Row 3: S03-C031, 帆を畳む船員 1; action context: 帆を畳む.
Row 4: S03-C036, 係留係 1; action context: 係留ロープを締める.
LOOP CONTINUITY LOCK: Treat the LEFT reference pose as the authority for the face, body and clothing; the RIGHT pose supplies the role tool. Hold the SAME tools and SAME colors/count of all portable props in ALL EIGHT frames, including frame 8. Never finish by switching to the empty-handed walking reference. Use small continuous hand, wrist, elbow, knee, hip and head movements around the fixed tool; pose 8 must naturally return to pose 1. Do not make props disappear/reappear or randomly recolor. Do not change a finished product into raw material within this short loop. For juggling or balloon work, every frame has exactly the same balls/balloons in the same colors, only positions change. A camera, paddle, net, watering can or steering wheel stays visible through the complete cycle.
